info.desc: Madonna is the debut studio album by American singer Madonna, released on July 27, 1983, via Sire Records. The album has an upbeat synthetic disco sound, using new technology of the time, including the Linn drum machine, Moog bass and Oberheim OB-X synthesizer. She sang in a bright, girlish timbre, with lyrics about love and relationships. To promote the album, Madonna performed one-off gigs in clubs and on television in the United States and United Kingdom throughout 1983 and 1984, followed by The Virgin Tour in 1985. The album was re-released in 1985 for the European market and re-packaged as .

podcast.body: Released in 1983, this was Madonna's first full-length album. It followed the style of her relatively successful first two singles, "Everybody" and "Burning Up," being easygoing, disco-oriented, and lively. At this point, Madonna had not yet developed a strong personality, and her lyrics did not convey much depth. The album included "Borderline," which is noted as being slightly more feminist and more characteristic of her later style. "Son fáciles, son discotequeros, son movidos."
